title: Smells toxic and dirty
text:
Smells toxic and dirty. First, it is a wrinkled mess - downright raggedy. Stinks like a factory (and dirty smell) but beware - its so much bigger than most washers can handle. Inacc description given. Reviews show thin item - its not.
When refund went thru - it was NOT FULL AMOUNT!
